jobs.title: CRM Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
We need someone to own our CRM automation. You will build workflows in GoHighLevel, connect Make and n8n scenarios, and maintain pipelines and funnels for our sales team. 3+ years experience with marketing automation required.

  • GoHighLevel workflows
  • Make / n8n
  • Webhooks and APIs

Fully remote, async friendly team. We offer health stipend and flexible hours. Apply with examples of automations you have built.
